title: Understanding Cross Validation
text: In 8-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$8$$ parts. Each part is used once as a validation set while the remaining $$7$$ parts form the training set.

title: Regularization Hyperparameter
text: The regularization hyperparameter is a value that controls the amount of regularization applied to the model. We need to test different values to find the best one.

title: Calculating the Number of Evaluations
text: For each value of the hyperparameter, we perform $$8$$ evaluations (one for each fold).

title: Determine the Total Evaluations
text: If there are $$11$$ different hyperparameter values and each requires $$8$$ evaluations, how many total evaluations are needed?

title: Final Answer
text: The total number of evaluations is the product of the number of folds and the number of hyperparameter values. $$8\times11$$
